B-EB5-own-black-first-01.notes: Al tocar el negro siempre empezó a sonar pero al tocar negro y planta no detecte un cambio bastante significativo qué diferenciará de solo negro

B-EB5-own-plant-first-01.notes: En este caso escuché en los tres nuevamente al tocar el negro, pero sonido o cambios perceptibles solo detecté en intento 1 y 3 al tocar la planta sin el negro en el 2 no logré detectar algo con solo planta.

findings: Black first: EB5 activated in 3/3 and all other box-5 nodes emitted MIDI during that phase.

Plant first: EB5 emitted MIDI only in first plant-only repetition; no EB5 MIDI in repetitions 2 and 3. ED5 emitted 12 NoteOns during plant-only repetition 3; operator perception in that repetition cannot be attributed to EB5 from these records.
Adding black after plant activated all five nodes in all three repetitions.
EB5 remained active for about 11.6 s into the third scheduled release phase, then returned to rest; physical release instant is not instrumented.
No node uptime decrease or offline state in either trial.
next_trial: EB5 plant only, 20 s contact x3, no contact with any black.
limitations: No calibrated signed analogue voltage measurement.
Operator audible observations are separate from raw-channel MIDI.
Baseline changed between sequential trials; contact order is not isolated from all time effects.
